title: feat(form): the record form names a visibleWhen clear-on-hide (objectui#8070)
body:
Fixes #8070
Clause-②: no

## What this does

The record form now names the objectui#6958 clear-on-hide. This applies ruling 5749200153 (letter A, ratified by the maintainer at 5809913547) at its default placement: one form-level notice under the form's existing outcome-toast id. The clear itself is unchanged. It is the same loop, skipping the same values and writing the same values.

- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, in the clear-on-hide effect (the one that keeps `previouslyHiddenFieldNames`): the loop that clears now also collects what it cleared and raises one `toast.warning` with `t('form.clearedOnHide', …)` under `outcomeToastId`. It names fields by `fieldLabelByName`, the same label source `validation.formInvalid` uses, joined by `t('validation.formInvalidJoiner')`. The `useSafeFormTranslation` fallback table carries the `en` row, wired like `form.submitFailed`.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: one key, `form.clearedOnHide`, in all ten packs, placed after `uploadInFlight` in each `form` block.
- One pin, `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/visiblewhen-clear-notice-8070.test.tsx`, beside the objectui#6958 pin. That pin is byte-unchanged (`git diff --quiet` against BASE `8740e86` exits 0) and green.
- One changeset, `.changeset/8070-name-visiblewhen-clear.md`, a patch for `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

Register: `warning`. Nothing failed, so it is not `error`. It is not `info` either, because the value leaves the record when the form is saved.

Two rules sit on top of "name what the pass clears". Each has its own pin leg and its own ablation below.

1. **A field is named only if it held something.** An empty list is rewritten as itself, so it is not named. `false` on a two-state control is not named either: `BOOLEAN_WIDGET_TYPES` in the same file defines `false` as that control's EMPTY state, and a create form seeds it. Without this rule, hiding an untouched checkbox on a create form raised a notice about a box that reads unchecked before and after (measured with a probe: `notices= ["Cleared — no longer applicable given the current values: Priority Support"]`). A checked box is still named. The clear still writes `null` over `false` exactly as before.
2. **A chained clear is named together with the clear that caused it.** One clear can hide a second field whose `visibleWhen` reads the field just cleared, and that second clear runs on the next pass. Suppose a pass starts from exactly the values the previous clearing pass left behind, compared with the file's own `computeDirty`. Then nothing was edited in between: the second pass is part of the same cascade. It names its fields together with the first pass's. Any edit in between starts a fresh list, and that case is pinned too.

## PM mechanism hypotheses: readings

- **H1: holds for one pass, falsified for a chained clear.** With the first one-pass implementation (commit `4c23e90`), the chained leg failed with `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)` and received `Cleared — no longer applicable given the current values: Role`. Contact had been cleared and was not named. That result is the reason for rule 2. Names are still collected only in the clear's own loop, and no visibility is recomputed anywhere else.
- **H2: holds.** I measured this once with a real sonner `Toaster` in a throwaway probe, not committed. After the transition there was 1 toast, carrying the notice text. After a client refusal there was still 1 toast, and the notice text was gone: sonner updated the toast in place. After an accepted attempt there were 0 toasts. The pin checks the same contract at the id level: the notice's id is the id of the refusal's `toast.error`, and the id that `toast.dismiss` receives at the next accepted attempt. The other direction: a transition while a refusal toast is showing replaces that toast with the notice. The refusal is still visible, as the client field highlights or, for a server refusal, the in-form `submitError` banner. A refusal can also replace a notice the user has not read yet. That refusal comes from the user's own next Save, which is how the ruling's "retires like its siblings" reads, so no second id was introduced.
- **H3: holds.** The joiner is `validation.formInvalidJoiner`, and the labels come from `fieldLabelByName` (`label`, then `name`, as `validation.formInvalid` does). Pinned: `Contact, Role` under `en`, and `Contact、Role` under `zh` (read from the zh pack, with no `, ` present).
- **H4: holds.** `form.submitFailed` lives in both the `useSafeFormTranslation` defaults table and each pack's `form` block, and the new key follows the same pattern. `check:i18n-keys` confirms every readable `createSafeTranslation` defaults row repeats the pack value.
- **H5: holds.** The key is in all ten packs, and `all-locales-key-parity` is green. No count is interpolated: each value ends in a colon and the list. `ar` and `ru` say "what no longer applies" (`ما` / `то, что`), so no word has to agree with the number of fields.

In the table the i18next placeholder is spelled FIELDS. The tree uses the double-brace form.

| pack | value |
|:--|:--|
| ar | تم مسح ما لم يعد ينطبق على القيم الحالية: FIELDS |
| de | Geleert, was für die aktuellen Werte nicht mehr gilt: FIELDS |
| en | Cleared — no longer applicable given the current values: FIELDS |
| es | Se borró lo que ya no corresponde a los valores actuales: FIELDS |
| fr | Ce qui ne s'applique plus aux valeurs actuelles a été effacé : FIELDS |
| ja | 現在の値に該当しなくなった項目をクリアしました: FIELDS |
| ko | 현재 값에 더 이상 해당하지 않는 항목을 비웠습니다: FIELDS |
| pt | O que não se aplica mais aos valores atuais foi limpo: FIELDS |
| ru | Очищено то, что больше не применимо к текущим значениям: FIELDS |
| zh | 已清空不再适用于当前取值的字段：FIELDS |

## Pin and reverse verification

The pin has 13 legs.

- **Named:**
  - A populated field that goes hidden produces one notice with its label, not its API name, under an id matching `form-outcome:`.
  - A checked two-state control is named.
  - Two fields cleared by one transition produce one notice, joined by the `en` joiner.
  - The same pair under `zh` is joined by U+3001.
  - A chained clear names both fields.
  - A separate later transition names only its own field.
  - Refusal supersedes the notice and the next accepted attempt dismisses it, under one id.
- **Not named:**
  - A field hidden while already empty.
  - A field holding an empty list.
  - An unchecked, seeded two-state control.
  - The first render of a record with a hidden populated field: no notice, and the payload keeps the value.
  - A transition that hides nothing.
  - A field that was already hidden and stays hidden.

All runs used the repo root, `pnpm exec vitest run` on the pin file, through the shared verify lock. The mutations went through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which confirmed each one landed on disk and restored the file to its HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

| leg | tree | exit | result |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| base | `form.tsx` at BASE `8740e86` (0 on-disk hits for the key) | 1 | `Tests 7 failed \| 6 passed (13)`. The six that pass are the absence legs. |
| after | HEAD `8a69de7` | 0 | `Tests 13 passed` |
| ablation: drop the chained carry | HEAD with that one line replaced | 1 | `1 failed \| 12 passed`: only the chained leg |
| ablation: drop the two-state rule | HEAD with that one condition replaced | 1 | `1 failed \| 12 passed`: only the unchecked leg |

## Gates at `8a69de7`

Each gate was run separately. Exit codes were written to a file before any pipe.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/renderers/form/ packages/i18n/` → exit 0, `Test Files 137 passed (137)`, `Tests 1634 passed | 10 skipped (1644)`.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2` → exit 0, `Tasks: 10 successful, 10 total`. The components `tsconfig.test.json` compiles this pin: an earlier implicit-any in it failed this gate and was fixed in `22b1755`.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 12 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files → exit 0, `0 errors`. No warning falls on a changed line, and the pin has none.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (0 `en` values changed, 1 key added), `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → each exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 13 changed paths → `NOT GOVERNED`.
- `check-changeset-claims` listed four pending changesets that name `en.ts` or `form.tsx` (6661, 5594, 5131, 5735). I read each paragraph. None of them says anything this diff moves.
- NOT MEASURED: the console eager-closure and bundle budget (`check:eager-closure`, `check:eager-locale-catalogues`). They need a full console build, which CI's Bundle Analysis runs. The addition is one short value per pack, so the eager `en` catalogue grows by one string.

`origin/main` was merged at `57a26d0` (merge base `a50600166`). `origin/main` has moved since, to `1daf477`, without touching any file in this change.

## Acceptance notes

- **Docs sentence: written in the docs round (`1c62b68`).** `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` now says that when the clear empties a field that held a value, the form raises one notice naming the cleared fields by their labels; that an already-empty field (an unchecked two-state control counts as empty) and the first render are not named; and that a later submit refusal replaces the notice. The seat widened this claim's surface by that one passage, as AGENTS.md #2 requires.
- **A record swap into a still-mounted form clears the incoming record's hidden, populated column.** This is a pre-existing behaviour of the objectui#6958 clear, and this PR does not revisit it, as the ruling requires. The baseline pass is recorded once per mount, not once per `defaultValues` reset. When a form shows record A with a field visible and then receives record B, where that field is hidden and populated, the swap reads as a VISIBLE to HIDDEN transition. Probe on BASE `form.tsx`: payload `crm_contact` was `null` and no notice was raised. Since this PR, that path raises the notice naming the column, so it is no longer silent, but the value is still cleared. The effect's own comment says "opening a record never nulls a column the user has not seen". This is reported for the seat to decide whether to file it. The probe was renderer-level, a rerender with new `defaultValues` and `previousValues`; I did not drive it in the console.
- objectui#6958 answers 404 on both the REST issue read and the web page, so its body could not be read (NOT MEASURED). I cited it through the objectui#6958 pin file and the clear effect's own comment.
